## Differential expression analysis - Linear models

::::: columns
::: {.column width="50%"}
-   dChip-normalized data
-   Not log2() scaled
-   Mean–variance dependence

VSN-transformation

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| code-overflow: scroll
#| code-block-height: 100px
# Extract only numerical expression columns
expr <- dat_clean_aug |>
  select(starts_with("GSM")) |>
  as.matrix()
# Fit VSN without additional sample-specific calibration
vsn_fit <- vsn2(expr, calib = "none")

# Transform expression values
expr_vsn <- predict(vsn_fit, newdata = expr)

# Reconstruct the wide-format dataset
dat_clean_aug_vsn <- bind_cols(
  dat_clean_aug |> select(-starts_with("GSM")),
  as.data.frame(expr_vsn)
)
```

\![\](results/figures/05_key_plot_1.png){fig-alt="Relationship between mean expression and standard deviation" width="80%"}

Nest and group by probe

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| code-overflow: scroll
#| code-block-height: 80px
dat_clean_aug_vsn_long_nested <- dat_clean_aug_vsn_long |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(probe_id)) |>
  dplyr::group_by(probe_id) |>
  tidyr::nest()
```
:::

::: {.column width="50%"}
Creating the model object

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| code-overflow: scroll
#| code-block-height: 100px
dat_clean_aug_vsn_long_nested <- dat_clean_aug_vsn_long_nested |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(
    model_object = map(
      data,
      ~lm(expression ~ state, data = .x)
    ),
    model_object_tidy = map(
      model_object,
      ~tidy(.x, conf.int = TRUE, conf.level = 0.95)
    )
  )
```

Volcano plot

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| code-overflow: scroll
#| code-block-height: 80px

volcano_plot <- ggplot(dat_estimates,
           aes(x = estimate, y = -log10(p_adj))) +
           geom_point(
           aes(color = significant),
          alpha = 0.5
         ) +
         labs(
         title = "Volcano plot of VSN-transformed expression",
         x = "Estimated difference in VSN-transformed expression",
        y = "-log10(adjusted p-value)"
        )+
        scale_color_manual(
        values = c("FALSE" = "#F8766D",
                    "TRUE" = "#00BFC4")
        ) +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(legend.position = "none")



```
